question: If you were summoned into the world of Re:Zero, what would you do first?
answer:
Despair.

We're assuming I get to bring my knowledge of Re:Zero with me, right?

I'm not loved by Satella, so I can't use Return by Death…

Despair. (laughs)

Would I go meet the people who were in the Royal Capital at that time?

Who would be the kindest person in the Royal Capital at that time… Ram is kind, but I don't think Ram would take a liking to me. (laughs)
